description: Election Commission- Notice Under Section 10A (1)(a) of the L.A.E.O Chavakachcheri  Praseshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically deals with electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that a member has vacated their office in the Chavakachcheri Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes, candidate status, and declarations by election officials regarding local authority membership.
